units.source_text: 源氏回思往日种种事情，觉得紫姬不肯同他开怀畅叙，乃一大恨事。

en.t: Genji thought back over many things from the past and felt it a great sorrow that Lady Murasaki would not open her heart and speak freely with him.

units.source_text: 这一天他整日住在这里，不到三公主那里去，

en.t: That day he stayed here all day and did not go to the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 派人送一信与三公主，信中说道：“今晨雪中受寒，身体颇感不适，拟在此安闲之处稍事休养。”

en.t: He sent someone with a letter to the Third Princess, writing, "I caught cold in the snow this morning and feel rather unwell, so I intend to rest for a while in this quiet place."

units.source_text: 三公主的乳母看了信，口头答道：“当将此意禀告公主。”

en.t: After reading the letter, the Third Princess's nurse gave a verbal reply: "I shall report this to the princess."
But there was no written reply.

units.source_text: 源氏觉得如此答复，太缺乏风趣了。

en.t: Genji thought such a response was far too lacking in charm.

units.source_text: 他生怕朱雀院闻知此事，心中不快，

en.t: He was deeply afraid that Suzaku In would hear of this and be displeased,

units.source_text: 意欲在这新婚期间常住那边，借以掩饰观听。

en.t: and he meant to stay often over there during this newly married period in order to quiet what people saw and heard.

units.source_text: 然而离开这里也不容易。

en.t: Yet leaving this place was not easy either.

units.source_text: 他想：“此种状况，我早就想到。

en.t: He thought, "I foresaw this sort of situation long ago.
Thinking it over alone, he was overwhelmed with distress.

units.source_text: 紫姬也觉得整天不去，对新人太不关怀，自己反而不好意思。

en.t: Lady Murasaki, too, felt embarrassed, thinking that for him not to go all day showed too little consideration for the new bride.
